verdict.rationale: Aircall states that its AI Assistants give real-time guidance and suggested responses during conversations and automatically capture notes (aircall-docs-22, aircall-docs-23). Its API exposes AI-derived call insights: transcriptions, sentiments, topics and summaries (aircall-docs-16). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how these insights appear inside the app (dashboards, analytics views), independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and evidence beyond marketing-level and API-reference descriptions.
